course.title: Power System Operation and Control
course.department: Department of Electrical and Electronic Engineering

content.value: Imagine you are a motor drive designer, and an industry asked you to design a speed controller for a slip-ring type induction motor using static Scherbius drive for half the rated motor torque and speed of 750 rpm. The specifications of the motor drive supplied by the industry are as follows:

Specifications: 3-φ, 440 V, 970 rpm, 6-pole, Y-connected, $R _ { s } = 0 . 1 \varOmega$ $R _ { r } ^ { \prime } = 0 . 0 8 \varOmega$ $X _ { s } = 0 . 3 \varOmega , X _ { r } ^ { \prime } = 0 . 4 \varOmega$ , stator to rotor turns ratio is 2, dc-link inductor resistance is 0.01 Ω, and transformer turns ratio is 8.
How will you select the firing angle of the drive mathematically for stable operation?

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 4th Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2016
